title: 6♠ as the only hand card is illegal

title: Legal 6♠ later fizzles when no discard remains

title: Nine +5 persists when controller has no discard
purpose: Prove ordered resolution does not roll back an already completed Goal increase.

title: Source Intercept rebinds controller-relative text

title: Visible illegal target rewinds completely

title: Combo-only counter answers a true Combo

title: LIFO response resolves before parent
purpose: Prove response stack order and renewed priority after the top item resolves.

title: Identical commands produce identical events and hashes
purpose: Certify command/event determinism without wall-clock or unordered iteration inputs.

title: Triggers queue during atomic resolution

title: Priority rotates through every player
purpose: Require one complete consecutive-pass cycle in turn order before resolution.

title: Counter removes the pending item

title: A player may counter their own pending play

title: Child play resolves before suspended parent resumes

title: Independent targets revalidate separately

title: Authorized replay preserves hidden choice without public leak
